561: // directive collects tokens until the directive's scope
562: // closes (either end of line or end of curly brace block).
563: // It expects the currently-loaded token to be a directive
564: // (or } that ends a server block). The collected tokens
565: // are loaded into the current server block for later use
566: // by directive setup functions.
567: func (p *parser) directive() error {
568: 
569: 	// a segment is a list of tokens associated with this directive
570: 	var segment Segment
571: 
572: 	// the directive itself is appended as a relevant token
573: 	segment = append(segment, p.Token())
574: 
575: 	for p.Next() {
576: 		if p.Val() == "{" {
577: 			p.nesting++
578: 			if !p.isNextOnNewLine() && p.Token().wasQuoted == 0 {
579: 				return p.Err("Unexpected next token after '{' on same line")
580: 			}
581: 			if p.isNewLine() {
582: 				return p.Err("Unexpected '{' on a new line; did you mean to place the '{' on the previous line?")
583: 			}
584: 		} else if p.Val() == "{}" {
585: 			if p.isNextOnNewLine() && p.Token().wasQuoted == 0 {
586: 				return p.Err("Unexpected '{}' at end of line")
587: 			}
588: 		} else if p.isNewLine() && p.nesting == 0 {
589: 			p.cursor-- // read too far
590: 			break
591: 		} else if p.Val() == "}" && p.nesting > 0 {
592: 			p.nesting--
593: 		} else if p.Val() == "}" && p.nesting == 0 {
594: 			return p.Err("Unexpected '}' because no matching opening brace")
595: 		} else if p.Val() == "import" && p.isNewLine() {
596: 			if err := p.doImport(1); err != nil {
597: 				return err
598: 			}
599: 			p.cursor-- // cursor is advanced when we continue, so roll back one more
600: 			continue
601: 		}
602: 
603: 		segment = append(segment, p.Token())
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	p.block.Segments = append(p.block.Segments, segment)
607: 
608: 	if p.nesting > 0 {
609: 		return p.EOFErr()
610: 	}
611: 
612: 	return nil
613: }
